entries.title: I Samuel 18:1
segments: ¶Now when he had finished speaking to Saul, the soul of Jonathan was knit to the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:2
segments: Saul took him that day, and would not let him go home to his father's house anymore.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:3
segments: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:4
segments: And Jonathan took off the robe that [was] on him and gave it to David, with his armor, even to his sword and his bow and his belt.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:5
segments: So David went out wherever Saul sent him, [and] behaved wisely. And Saul set him over the men of war, and he was accepted in the sight of all the people and also in the sight of Saul's servants.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:6
segments: ¶Now it had happened as they were coming [home], when David was returning from the slaughter of the Philistine, that the women had come out of all the cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet King Saul, with tambourines, with joy, and with musical instruments.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:7
segments: So the women sang as they danced, and said: "Saul has slain his thousands, And David his ten thousands."

entries.title: I Samuel 18:8
segments: Then Saul was very angry, and the saying displeased him; and he said, "They have ascribed to David ten thousands, and to me they have ascribed [only] thousands. Now [what] more can he have but the kingdom?"

entries.title: I Samuel 18:9
segments: So Saul eyed David from that day forward.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:10
segments: And it happened on the next day that the distressing spirit from God came upon Saul, and he prophesied inside the house. So David played [music] with his hand, as at other times; but [there was] a spear in Saul's hand.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:11
segments: And Saul cast the spear, for he said, "I will pin David to the wall!" But David escaped his presence twice.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:12
segments: ¶Now Saul was afraid of David, because the LORD was with him, but had departed from Saul.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:13
segments: Therefore Saul removed him from his presence, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:14
segments: And David behaved wisely in all his ways, and the LORD [was] with him.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:15
segments: Therefore, when Saul saw that he behaved very wisely, he was afraid of him.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:16
segments: But all Israel and Judah loved David, because he went out and came in before them.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:17
segments: Then Saul said to David, "Here is my older daughter Merab; I will give her to you as a wife. Only be valiant for me, and fight the LORD'S battles." For Saul thought, "Let my hand not be against him, but let the hand of the Philistines be against him."

entries.title: I Samuel 18:18
segments: So David said to Saul, "Who [am] I, and what [is] my life [or] my father's family in Israel, that I should be son-in-law to the king?"

entries.title: I Samuel 18:19
segments: But it happened at the time when Merab, Saul's daughter, should have been given to David, that she was given to Adriel the Meholathite as a wife.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:20
segments: Now Michal, Saul's daughter, loved David. And they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:21
segments: So Saul said, "I will give her to him, that she may be a snare to him, and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him." Therefore Saul said to David a second time, "You shall be my son-in-law today."

entries.title: I Samuel 18:22
segments: And Saul commanded his servants, "Communicate with David secretly, and say, 'Look, the king has delight in you, and all his servants love you. Now therefore, become the king's son-in-law.'"

entries.title: I Samuel 18:23
segments: So Saul's servants spoke those words in the hearing of David. And David said, "Does it seem to you [a] light [thing] to be a king's son-in-law, seeing I [am] a poor and lightly esteemed man?"

entries.title: I Samuel 18:24
segments: And the servants of Saul told him, saying, "In this manner David spoke."

entries.title: I Samuel 18:25
segments: Then Saul said, "Thus you shall say to David: 'The king does not desire any dowry but one hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to take vengeance on the king's enemies.'" But Saul thought to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:26
segments: So when his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to become the king's son-in-law. Now the days had not expired;

entries.title: I Samuel 18:27
segments: therefore David arose and went, he and his men, and killed two hundred men of the Philistines. And David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full count to the king, that he might become the king's son-in-law. Then Saul gave him Michal his daughter as a wife.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:28
segments: Thus Saul saw and knew that the LORD [was] with David, and [that] Michal, Saul's daughter, loved him;

entries.title: I Samuel 18:29
segments: and Saul was still more afraid of David. So Saul became David's enemy continually.

entries.title: I Samuel 18:30
segments: Then the princes of the Philistines went out [to war]. And so it was, whenever they went out, [that] David behaved more wisely than all the servants of Saul, so that his name became highly esteemed.
